**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee exists anywhere in the Agreement. Supporting points:

- **§ 9.4** — convenience termination on 30 days' notice; we owe Fees only for conforming Services through the termination date, with refund of prepaid Fees.
- **§ 7.1** — Vendor may not impose minimum-use or similar charges not identified in the Order Form.
- **§ 27.3** — termination for prolonged force majeure "without penalty."
- **§ 24.4** — no acceleration of Fees on our change of control.

This satisfies the preferred position, so no redline was proposed. Noted but not flagged here: the § 2.1 three-year USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment creates real economic exposure, but it is not cast as liquidated damages or a penalty and belongs to the minimum-commitment rule (MINCOMMIT) — flagging it here would double-count the same commercial term.
